meta_description:
31K likes, 306 comments - milindrunning on September 21, 2026: "Did it AGAIN !!!! Six days later one more Ironman 😁 Doing Ironman Wales on the 13th of September and Ironman Italy on 19th September was a great experience!!
This one was to learn new lessons on recovery, which is important to understand individual levels of fitness. One aspect of fitness is the time required to recover from a particular stress, to be able to do it again with the same level of comfort. A lot of interesting lessons 😀 What are your thoughts on recovery ?".
